section: G.E.H.Aʼs Standard and High Medicare Advantage plans benefit from these features:
text:
G.E.H.Aʼs Standard and High Medicare Advantage plans benefit from these features:
+ A $2,100 annual out-of-pocket cap for prescriptions. This eliminates what was previously known as the Medicare 'donut hole,' which left beneficiaries potentially exposed to higher cost share. G.E.H.A's Medicare Advantage plans are designed to cover 100% of your Part D prescription drugs once you've reached the out-of-pocket cap.
+ Enjoy a $35 cap on insulin monthly
+ $0 copay for vaccinations and preventive medications
